segments.t: At the bar counter, Sveta asks Katya why she interrogated her about Denis if she is dating Nikita, and slyly mentions that Denis is only trying to make Katya jealous. When Denis kisses Sveta to prove his point, Katya grabs birthday boy Senya and kisses him back.
Зачем ты про Дениса спрашивала, если с Никитой?
Слушай, пей своё красное вино, оно полезно.
Просто Денис думает, что ты будешь поревновать.
Это полный бред, ведь я здесь с Никитой.
А Денис пусть себе думает, что хочет.
Я вообще не понял, что это сейчас было?
Возможно, ей действительно очень нравится директор Никита.
А ты в этой истории просто третий лишний.
Сейчас мы быстро посмотрим, кто третий лишний!
Сеня, подойди ко мне и быстро поцелуй меня!
Ладно, друзья, всем спокойной ночи, я спать.
Спокойной ночи, смотри в темноте не наступи никому!
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Зачем ты про Дениса спрашивала, если с Никитой?
'Why were you asking about Denis if you are with Nikita?' By wondering why Denis asking about Denis if Denis is with Nikita was, Sveta presses Denis for a straight answer.
Слушай, пей своё красное вино, оно полезно.
'Listen, drink your red wine, it is healthy.' Noting that Denis should drink Denis's red wine it is healthy keeps Katya's side of the story simple and clear.
Просто Денис думает, что ты будешь поревновать.

'Denis just thinks that you will feel jealous.' Even though Denis just thinks that Denis will feel jealous, Sveta keeps a steady face in front of Denis. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
Это полный бред, ведь я здесь с Никитой.
'That is total nonsense, because I am here with Nikita.' Admitting that that is total nonsense because she is here with Nikita shows Katya being honest for a change.
А Денис пусть себе думает, что хочет.
'And let Denis think whatever he wants.' Because Denis should let Denis think whatever he wants, Katya treats the matter as settled.
Я вообще не понял, что это сейчас было?

'I did not understand at all, what was that just now?' Denis asks whether he did not understand at all what was that just now, refusing to let the point slide. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
Возможно, ей действительно очень нравится директор Никита.
'Perhaps she really likes director Nikita very much.' Adding that perhaps she really likes director Nikita very much fills in the missing piece for Denis.
А ты в этой истории просто третий лишний.

'And in this story you are simply the third wheel.' Sveta tells Denis that in this story Denis is simply the third wheel without dressing it up. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Сейчас мы быстро посмотрим, кто третий лишний!

'Right now we will quickly see who is the third wheel!' Because right now they will quickly see who is the third wheel, Denis does not bother softening the blow for Katya. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Сеня, подойди ко мне и быстро поцелуй меня!
'Senya, come over to me and kiss me quickly!' Once Denis should come over to her and kiss her quickly, Katya makes sure Denis hears every word.
Ладно, друзья, всем спокойной ночи, я спать.
'Alright, friends, good night to everyone, I am going to sleep.' Denis reminds Katya that Alright friends good night to everyone he is going to sleep before the moment passes.
Спокойной ночи, смотри в темноте не наступи никому!

'Good night, be careful not to step on anyone in the dark!' Between the truth and the shift, Sveta delivers a sharp reaction. Russian puts the key word right up front so her emotion lands on the first beat. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.

Сеня, подойди ко мне и быстро поцелуй меня!
Ладно, друзья, всем спокойной ночи, я спать.

While the birthday party ends in romantic chaos, Lyova climbs into his bunk at Ainura's apartment just before a midnight police raid. See you next time!
Всего хорошего!
